subfiles.title: Hornbeck memorandum on Japanese news agencies and foreign correspondents
subfiles.from: Stanley K. Hornbeck, U.S. State Department Far Eastern Division
subfiles.about: Hornbeck records a conversation with Hiroshi Saitō concerning Japanese news agencies in the United States and Owen Lattimore’s conception of a correspondent’s work abroad.
subfiles.summary: Hornbeck discusses Japanese news agencies in the US with Saitō, citing Lattimore's views on foreign correspondents.

subfiles.title: List of papers on Japanese news-gathering agencies
subfiles.about: An internal index summarizes records numbered 17–22 concerning Japanese news-agency consolidation, international press contracts, and Dōmei’s distribution of fabricated news.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1934-39) covers merging Japanese news agencies into Domei, their AP and UP ties, and British complaints about fabricated news.

interest: Shows 1930s formation of Japan's Domei news agency, its US wire-service ties, and a propaganda dispute with Britain.
